metadata.description: Sebastian Sulinski's personal Claude Code commands and agents

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Critical review — /review:scrutinise for deep forensic review of recent work, /review:plan-review for multi-agent grounded review of a plan file, /review:plan-verify to confirm a plan was fully and correctly implemented.

plugins.name: session
plugins.description: Session bookends — resume the previous session, and capture end-of-session state so the next resumes cleanly.

plugins.name: repo
plugins.description: Repository lifecycle — fully deprecate and archive a repository.

plugins.name: release
plugins.description: Releases — run the full changelog, git tag, and GitHub release workflow.

plugins.name: requirements
plugins.description: Requirements gathering — exhaustively interrogate a project's requirements before any code is written.

plugins.name: db
plugins.description: Database tooling — read-only audit of Eloquent and query-builder usage, flagging performance and memory wins.

plugins.name: dead-code
plugins.description: Codebase hygiene — find and safely remove dead code and unused dependencies, only after explicit approval.

plugins.name: worktree
plugins.description: Parallel workspaces — create isolated git worktrees (plain repositories and submodules) so multiple agents can work on different plans simultaneously without file collisions, and clean up a session's own redundant worktrees and branches afterwards.

plugins.name: explain
plugins.description: Plain-language explanations — turn the previous outcome or a named subject into an explanation a non-technical reader can follow: what changed, what it fixes, and what they will notice. Read-only.

plugins.name: gitgraph
plugins.description: Git history as a page — /gitgraph opens the whole commit graph of the repository or a submodule in your browser (or the Claude desktop app's built-in browser with -i): refs tree, uncommitted changes in every worktree, find by commit or by changed file, commit details with per-hunk diffs, copy and add-to-prompt.
